entries.name: Cerberus Testing
entries.summary: 开源低代码端到端测试平台（GPL-3.0），以 Web 界面创建可复用的自动化测试用例与 campaign，经执行机器人对 Web、移动、API 等应用自动执行，并汇总逐用例判定与失败证据；自托管 Web 应用，非厂商托管云。

leaf_matches.reason: README 与官网正文说明：以 Web 界面低代码创建自动化测试用例，支持 Web/iOS/Android/API 应用，把用例编入 campaign 后按计划或经 Jenkins/Gitlab/Bitbucket 在 CI/CD 触发，跨环境、浏览器、设备并行执行；features 页列出测试需求管理、可复用步骤模块、Reporting/Traceability/Replay（逐用例结果、失败重跑、截图、回放、日志）与网络流量采集。这对应“被测应用作为整体经真实用户界面驱动 + 持久可复用的测试资产 + 自动执行与逐测试判定及故障证据”。它是 GPL-3.0 完整自托管 Web 应用（INSTALL 要求 Tomcat + MySQL/MariaDB 或 Docker composition），不是纯库/CLI，也不是厂商托管测试云；关系限定于社区版自托管形态。

features: README: low-code test automation platform supporting Web, iOS, Android and API (REST, SOAP, Kafka) applications.
README: automated testcases are created through an easy-to-use web interface and grouped into campaigns, scheduled or triggered from Jenkins/Gitlab/Bitbucket with email/Slack notifications.
features page: low-code test library with modular reusable test steps, requirements management, campaign management and advanced campaign reporting.
features page: scalable parallel execution across environments, browsers, devices, countries and locations through native execution robots.
features page: reporting, traceability and replay covering steps, actions, controls, robots and network traffic; screenshots, replay and logging for failed runs.
features page: network traffic data capture, dynamic test data management and native audit/logging.
deployment: INSTALL: self-hosted deployment with Tomcat 9, MySQL 5.6/MariaDB 10.1 and Java JDK 11, or via docker/compositions/cerberus-tomcat-mysql (Keycloak variant included).
README: Docker images published for MySQL, Tomcat and Tomcat with Keycloak adapter; demo instance at demo.cerberus-testing.com. 本轮未运行或部署。
